flora_context: Cap and Gills (the umbrella top and the ribbed underside)
Mycelium (the 'invisible' white threads underground that do the eating)
Shelf Fungus (hard, bracket-like growths on tree trunks)
Spore Cloud (fine dust-like particles dropping from the gills)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'polka-dot' or 'ribbed' textures; bold colors to stand out against the brown mud.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A classic red-capped mushroom with white spots; Top-Right: The underside showing the gills; Bottom-Left: A bracket fungus growing on a scaly Rimu log; Bottom-Right: A web of white mycelium threads in dark soil.
visual_logic.ground: Rich, dark brown decomposing leaf litter.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, even light to show the contrast between the white gills and the dark earth.
